For a project-specific question, search the configured knowledge lakes and nested project `README.md` files before a broad grep, read the relevant note before repeating the investigation, and when your work establishes a verified decision, constraint or recurring fix that a future task would use, record it in the appropriate lake. Search first so you can update existing coverage or add what is missing; leave one-off session details out. A blank search lists recent docs; `help` shows the lakes and ranking. `read` returns a lake doc verbatim plus its revision token; `instructions:` results open with the built-in read tool. `add` creates or replaces a knowledge doc (replace needs that revision); `check` audits convention compliance.
